title_zh: 快递送错门引发的“案件”
title_en: Chinese Humor (19/20): The Case of the Misdelivered Package
note_en: 才 after a time or effort phrase means "only then, not until": 两人对照了半天地址，才发现门牌号看错了一位数 "they compared addresses for ages before realizing one digit had been misread." English often flips the logic with "not until" or "before," while Chinese keeps the order of events and lets 才 signal that the discovery came late. Compare 就, which signals the opposite, that something happened early or easily.

sentences.en: Mix-ups like this, with packages delivered to the wrong door because of similar apartment numbers, play out in residential complexes almost every day in China, which has led the world in parcel volume for years. Netizens even have a name for these short videos, "delivery fail scenes," and jokingly call them the cheapest "mystery drama" of city life.
